description: Defines an enumeration DepositAccountType representing different types of deposit accounts in the Fineract system, including methods for type conversion, type checks, and resource name retrieval.

classes.name: DepositAccountType
classes.description: Enumeration of deposit account types with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the deposit account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the deposit account type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding DepositAccountType enum value.

methods.name: isSavingsDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the deposit account type is SAVINGS_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isFixedDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the deposit account type is FIXED_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the deposit account type is RECURRING_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isCurrentDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the deposit account type is CURRENT_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the deposit account type is INVALID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the deposit account type, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: resourceName
methods.description: Returns the resource name associated with the deposit account type.
